title: Useless
body: Practically anything useful is behind the pay wall that’s subscription based. You are wasting your time checking all the introductions on the app
author: 3breze

title: Scammed
body: I wanted 7 days free trial but as every other app it makes you click subscribe. So I did and it charged me for the whole amount. However I didn’t like the app - you cannot define yearly goal for instance, but when I canceled sub, I didn’t get money back. Now I need to waste my time asking for refund.
author: assrtuvdbjf

title: Enjoying Productivity For The First Time
body:
I am honestly enjoying seeing my tasks on the phone! 

I have the app as a widget showing what I set for myself to do and it keeps me focused throughout the day.

Also, it is very helpful having the guidance for certain healthy habits there already. 

Overall very satisfied, it’s simple, effective and all-inclusive. Recommend to everyone!
author: guga mesar

title: Subpar Apple Watch app
body: Overall great app. However, the Apple Watch version lacks basic functionality like checking off single instances of a “goal” habit. Also, you should polish the core mechanic of your iOS app - swiping off habits and tapping on “1” or “2” buttons. It’s a little bit wonky, the buttons don’t have a pressed visual state and swiping sometimes  checks off the wrong habit due to some weird sorting issue.
author: Vik7373
